cues: The benefits are real: higher yields with less spraying, stress tolerance, healthier food, cheap medicines.
So are the concerns: possible allergens, gene flow to wild relatives, harm to insects we did not target, and farmers depending on bought, patented seed.
That is why countries regulate them under the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety.
